name: Physics v2: stairs, a ledge grab and mantle, crouching under a roof, ice, and bullets with and without continuous collision

steps.note: One frame so the Player's visual script starts (its input actions are known from then on).

assert.label: the player starts on the floor

steps.note: Walk right up five 0.25 m steps onto the 1.25 m landing.

assert.label: walked up the stairs onto the landing

steps.note: On, off the landing and up to the 2 m wall.

assert.label: on the ground at the wall

steps.note: Jump while pushing toward the wall: grabLedges catches the ledge on the way down.
Crouch and walk under the low roof, then let go of crouch: no room to stand.
Pushed at 5 m/s: the crate on ice slides much further than the one on wood.

assert.label: the crate on wood stopped early
the crate on ice kept sliding

steps.note: Bullets fired at 300 m/s at a 4 cm wall at x = 16.

assert.label: without continuous collision the bullet passed through
with continuous collision it stopped at the wall
